body:
Maps existing repertoire snapshot projection, position index and scheduling occurrence interface on the scheduling census dependency. Records detached source identities and existing contracts without granting writer or issuance authority. The census remains partial.

Validation: component checker, 234 boundary/integration tests and 11 position occurrence tests passed. Nineteen previously reported fixture failures and ten missing-adapter errors remain unresolved. Native and live behavior were not qualified.

## Summary by Sourcery

Map repertoire snapshot sources into the component census without granting writer or issuance authority.

New Features:
- Add a repertoire snapshot census covering snapshot projection, position indexing, and scheduling occurrence interfaces.

Enhancements:
- Record repertoire snapshot source ownership and dependencies while preserving detached identities and limiting the census to non-authoritative contracts.
- Extend component validation and integration coverage to enforce repertoire snapshot ownership and detect newly tracked files.

Documentation:
- Document the new repertoire snapshot ownership scope and its authority boundaries.

Tests:
- Add census checks for repertoire snapshot discovery, ownership, and preventing removal of all scope owners.
title: Map repertoire snapshot ownership
head: codex/completion-t02-repertoire-snapshot-census
